tasks.title: Modify PROMPT.md
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-specify/PROMPT.md. Use selected architecture and the current project layout. FR-001.
Prior review history: .gwrk/review-history/phase-01-through-2026-11-18T2113Z.json. Preserve host dependency and verification guidance, conditional checklist authority, PR attribution, project lead escalation and Decided priority over Proposed targets. Both new regressions failed before repair. The phase gate passes 53 tests. Independent clearance remains required.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Project enforcement in specification dispatch — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-specify/PROMPT.md:1-11
  EXPECTED: The built-in specification template exposes an active `<code_quality>` block containing `{{enforcement}}`. The assembled prompt includes the applicable project-local enforcement rule.
  ACTUAL: `<scope_constraints>` follows the header without an enforcement slot. The dispatch capture omits the local rule that the planning capture includes.
  FIX: Add the trusted enforcement slot used by the planning template. Run the phase gate with the project-local policy fixture.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Specification guidance for an unknown project profile — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-specify/PROMPT.md:22-35,83-106
  EXPECTED: Dispatch uses host dependency evidence and repository layout when the project has no detected stack or selected design.
  ACTUAL: `conditionPrompt` returns the raw template for `type: "unknown"`. The captured specification prompt includes `specs/000-build-plan.md` and `docs/grounding/architecture.md`.
  FIX: Render the host fallback for an unknown profile at definition dispatch. Keep the GWRK paths exclusive to the native profile.

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: gates/phase-01.sh, re-opened by review):
The review agent raised a finding on this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/plugins/builtins/workflows/gwrk-specify/PROMPT.md — Insert `<code_quality>` with `{{enforcement}}` on its own line before `<scope_constraints>`. In `src/plugins/workflow-governance.delivery.test.ts`, create `.gwrk/plugins/skills/phase-01-policy/manifest.yaml` with `tier: enforcement` and `scope: implementation`, plus a `SKILL.md` with a unique rule. Assert that real dry-run dispatch puts the rule inside `<code_quality>` for both `gwrk-specify` and `gwrk-plan`.
FIX: src/plugins/workflow-runtime.ts — In `executeWorkflow`, pass `{ renderUnknownGuards: true }` to `conditionPrompt` only for `gwrk-specify` and `gwrk-plan`. Add that optional third argument in `src/domain/prompt-conditioner.ts`. For an opted-in `type: "unknown"`, retain unguarded text and unwrap only `[type: generic]` blocks. Drop native and language-specific blocks. Preserve design metadata and omit `<project_profile>`.
FIX: src/plugins/workflow-governance.delivery.test.ts — Add captured-dispatch cases for both workflows with `{ type: "unknown" }`. Assert that specification uses host dependency evidence and repository layout. Assert that planning uses host architecture documents and verification commands and requires a fenced `bash` gate. Reject `docs/grounding/architecture.md`, `specs/000-build-plan.md`, `pnpm run build`, `python -m pytest`, and raw `[type: ...]` markers in both captures. Keep the native and Python gate example assertions in `src/plugins/workflow-governance.test.ts`.
FIX: specs/045-workflow-governance/plan.md — Extend Phase 1’s `TR-012` assertion to cover project-local enforcement and unknown-profile dispatch alongside decision authority. Before applying the production fixes, run `bash specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-01.sh` and verify that all three regressions fail and the Principal Engineer checks pass.
FIX: specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-01.sh — After the production fixes, rerun the gate with the build and all six suites enabled. Require exit `0` and retain the assertions for the verbatim decision index and the instruction to record conflicts in the plan.
